fixes.explanation: Something solemn sounds right, and I see the pull. But look at what Jesus says: “…so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom…” The disciples are getting a meal, not a ceremony. I think that's a pretty big honor for men who had just been arguing about who was the greatest.
